answer: Make rewards vest at glacier pace: each identity's earnings unlock over 90 days, and any key later linked to a sybil cluster (shared funding source, matching timing fingerprints) forfeits everything still locked to the honest pool. An attacker running 500 keys must keep 500 backlogs frozen for months, and one detection burns the whole cluster. Payout reaches its zenith only after a full vesting cycle, so a burst of fake agents as brief as a sonnet earns almost nothing before audit.
